thread:
maria_g: quick sync 1 copy sprint for site pages across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. goal: final hero lines + one supporting sentence each, three social launch posts, and webinar hook. 15m.

alex_reeves: i'll lead the benchmark blurb. target soundbite: concise stat + short method note. e.g. "internal benchmarks show up to 3x lower serving cost at comparable latency (p95)", with footnote for env.

sam_k: webinar angle: make it practical 1 title option: "Serving Economics: How to Lower Cost Without Breaking Latency". promo plan: teaser, metric highlight, registration push.

liz_h: ops/cs liaison: i'll ask for a 1-2 sentence customer line. prefer non-identifying unless we get permission. also inbound routing: we should collect mode_interest + company_size + compliance_flag + cloud_provider.

emma_design: CTA normalization: Hosted = Try, Dedicated = Reserve, Private = Request review. I'll mock three hero variants and a short gif to show scale difference.

maria_g: copy constraints: hero headline <= 8 words; subhead <= 18 words. Variant A = performance-first, Variant B = trust-first. we'll A/B in paid channels and measure demo CTR.

alex_reeves: draft hero candidates: Hosted A: "Generate in minutes, pay-as-you-go" Hosted B: "Fast, reliable text generation with usage-based pricing" Dedicated A: "Reserved GPU capacity, consistent throughput" Dedicated B: "Predictable SLAs for critical workloads" Private A: "VPC & on-prem inference for regulated data" Private B: "Control and compliance for sensitive ML workloads"

rory_growth: launch cadence: Day -3 teaser (product value), Day 0 benchmark + blog, Day +2 webinar invite, Day +7 case study follow-up. social: 2 feed posts + 4 stories the week of. assets: hero gif, short chart PNG, 30s promo.

cs_bot: CS note: "Customer feedback: reduced peak tail latency ~35% after moving to reserved capacity." (flag: confirm permission id=case-452).

maria_g: legal check: alex, avoid absolutes. add parenthetical: "(internal benchmark; workloads described in footnote)". legal will require customer opt-in for name.

alex_reeves: will add methodology line: "Benchmarks run on representative open models across 8x A100-equivalent nodes; results vary by model and prompt mix."

liz_h: inbound webhook mapping for eng: payload below. devs please implement routing rules described after.

```
POST /hooks/marketing-leads
{
  "email": "...",
  "mode_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "company_size": "...",
  "compliance_flag": "yes|no",
  "cloud_provider": "aws|gcp|azure|other"
}
```

Routing logic (to implement): if company_size >= 1000 OR compliance_flag == "yes" -> enterprise queue; else -> nurture flow. Also tag mode_interest and cloud_provider in HubSpot. Return 200 on success.

emma_design: Private page UX: add single-click "Request private review" CTA above the fold that opens a prefilled modal for logged-in users. also show a tiny trust panel with "SLA & KMS support" bullet points.

sam_k: webinar-bot: can you create an event stub for May 7, 2026 10am PT titled "Serving Economics: How to Lower Cost Without Breaking Latency" and include registration link?

webinar-bot: Event created: "Serving Economics: How to Lower Cost Without Breaking Latency" - 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. registration: https://events.redwood.ai/serve-economics. Reminder: add partner co-host by EOD Friday to enable cross-promo.

maria_g: timeline: copy freeze Tue COB, creative freeze Wed, announcement live next Monday. alex -> benchmark draft by Mon EOD; liz -> CS blurbs by Mon afternoon; emma -> assets mock by Tue AM. i'll consolidate and create Asana tasks. thanks everyone.
